messages:
maya: Kicking off eu-central-2 region bring-up. Window Thu 03:00-07:00 UTC. Primary goals: bootstrap GPU pools, run gradual-burn validation, 2h soak at target QPS, then autoscaler tuning and handoff. I'll post the checklist and baseline configs here.

maya: Checklist (short):
- Provision 8x A100 per AZ (gpu-serving nodepool)
- LB + NAT + BGP peerings verified
- DB replicas seeded in region
- k8s nodepools with taints: gpu=true:NoSchedule
- Firewall rules: only control-plane and loadgen IPs allowed
- Observability: metrics, traces, logs to eu-central-2 cluster

dylan: I will stand up load generators on cloud-runner-3. Plan: start at 150 streams (~800 rps) for warm-up, then 2-step ramp to 1200 rps for soak. Will post loadctl commands before starting.

sophie: I'll watch SLOs and infra alerts. Quick note: set a p95 latency alert at 600ms to trigger circuit-breaker testing.

maya: Baseline autoscaler config to use as starting point:
```yaml
autoscaler:
  mode: target-utilization
  metric: gpu_utilization
  target: 0.50
  scale_up:
    stabilization: 60s
    step: 2
  scale_down:
    stabilization: 120s
    step: 1
  min_nodes: 4
  max_nodes: 20
  binpack: false
```

maya: We'll start with binpack=false to observe distribution, then toggle binpack to reduce fragmentation if costs spike.

chris: Quick cost note: at projected soak (~1k rps) with these A100 shapes we're ~ $7-10/hr per node. Recommend max_nodes=20 cap and enable spend alerts at $120/hr for region. :money_with_wings:

praveen: Suggest running a warmup scenario that simulates cached prefixes to validate KV/prefix cache hit ratio. If cache hit < 60% we should increase warmup size.

dylan: Preparing load start. Load script (internal):
```bash
# start soak
loadctl --target https://eu-central-2.api.redwood.svc --streams 150 --duration 15m --mode warmup
# ramp
loadctl --target https://eu-central-2.api.redwood.svc --streams 600 --duration 30m --mode ramp
loadctl --target https://eu-central-2.api.redwood.svc --streams 1200 --duration 2h --mode soak
```
I'll post the loadctl job link when started.

autoscale-bot: deploy-success maya/region-bootstrap v1.3 at 1768590201

sophie: Observability note: enable these dashboards and set sticky time window to 4h: gpu_utilization, token_throughput, p95_latency, cache_hit_rate, pod_evictions.

dylan: Starting warmup in T-10m. Posting logs to http://logs.internal/eu-central-2/soak-run-1768590123

sophie: Seeing elevated TCP retransmits in az-b+az-c path. Opening ENGINFRA-1247. Possible MTU mismatch on transit gateway. If it persists we should restrict soak to az-a only to avoid false negatives.

dylan: Rolling load to az-a only and lowering concurrency to 120 streams while we investigate.

maya: If we narrow to a single AZ, ensure we still test autoscale under stress. We'll keep the soak duration, but note single-AZ caveat in runbook.

chris: Adjusting cost cap: enabling a temporary spend cap alarm and tagging all GPUs with billing=soak-eu-c2.

praveen: Added warmup payloads to increase prefix cache hit. Running a targeted cache warm-up job now (20m).

dylan: Soak reached: 2h steady at target streams. Quick metrics snapshot — p95=210ms, p99=520ms, CPU avg 62%, GPU avg 74%, cache_hit_rate 68%, node_count 12. Posting full metrics link: http://metrics.internal/eu-central-2/1768590123

sophie: From infra side: no pod OOMs, 0.7% restarts, no persistent disk IO spikes. Network retransmits reduced after MTU tweak on transit gateway. Marking networking as resolved for now.

maya: Time to tune autoscaler. Proposal: enable binpack=true, tighten thresholds to be more aggressive on scale-up but keep conservative scale-down.

maya: Proposed autoscaler v3 changes:
```yaml
autoscaler:
  mode: target-utilization
  metric: gpu_utilization
  target: 0.45
  scale_up:
    stabilization: 45s
    step: 3
  scale_down:
    stabilization: 180s
    step: 1
  min_nodes: 4
  max_nodes: 20
  binpack: true
  cool_down: 60s
```

sophie: I'll apply v3 to a canary subset (label: autoscale-canary=true) and observe 1h. Abort criteria: p95 > 900ms or pod restarts > 5% in 10m.

dylan: Canary applied to 3 nodepools. Simulating traffic spikes now to validate no oscillation.

autoscale-bot: autoscaler-change applied to cluster eu-central-2 at 1768590255 by maya

dylan: Canary run results: no oscillation, scale events matched expected windows. Observed smoother packing, ~12% cost reduction on nodes for same throughput.

sophie: Canary green. Promoting v3 to region. Updating alert thresholds accordingly.

maya: Handoff plan: 1) Finalize confluence runbook with notes and metric links, 2) Post-mortem / retrospective scheduled for next Tue, 3) Handoff to product-eng and support at 08:30 UTC.

chris: I added cost projection summary to confluence page and set a follow-up to re-evaluate binpack after 72h of steady state.

maya: Thanks team. Final status: bring-up complete, soak passed (with single-AZ caveat resolved), autoscale profile v3 promoted, cost caps in place. Handoff to product-eng scheduled.

praveen: Leaving a note to run a KV cache revalidation job in 24h once production traffic patterns arrive.

maya: Closing thread. Will upload final artifacts and links to runbook. :white_check_mark:
